xtmux-bbc.description:
## PROBLEM

Discovered 2026-07-20: 22 orphan bun processes running \`sp run executor/debugger\` from Jul 14 (r6g sprint), all with PPID=1 (parent tmux panes gone), consuming ~1Gi RAM. The existing reap cron script (\`/home/dawid/projects/mercury/infra/scripts/serena_orphan_killer.sh\`, cron */30) targets ONLY \`serena start-mcp-server\` processes — the bun sp orphans slip through and accumulate indefinitely.

Same root cause as serena reap: specialist processes spawned inside a tmux pane don't get reaped when the pane/orchestrator dies. But sp children have different process signatures (\`bun ... sp run executor|debugger --bead <id>\`), so the serena-scoped script doesn't match them.

## SUCCESS

- A companion or extended reap script kills orphan \`bun.*sp run (executor|debugger)\` processes with PPID=1 and etime > threshold (e.g., 6h — same default as serena)
- Cron entry runs it periodically (either extend the existing */30 slot or add a sibling entry)
- Logged to \`\$HOME/.local/state/sp-orphan-killer.log\` for observability

## SCOPE

Two options:

**A (small, additive)**: create \`serena_orphan_killer_sp.sh\` sibling in \`mercury/infra/scripts/\` mirroring serena_orphan_killer.sh structure; add cron line to run it \`*/30\`. ~40 LOC.

**B (unify)**: refactor \`serena_orphan_killer.sh\` to a generic \`orphan_killer.sh --pattern <regex>\` that reads a config listing which patterns to reap; invoke twice (or from cron with different args). ~60 LOC + config file.

Option A wins on ponytail (no abstraction until second reason to unify).

## NON_GOALS

- Do NOT reap active pane children (PPID != 1) — only orphans
- Do NOT touch active worktrees/beads state — reaping is process-level only, storage/DB left alone
- Do NOT enable dry-run by default — mirror serena script's ergonomics

## VALIDATION

- Manual: create 2 test orphan processes, run script with 0s threshold + dry-run, verify only matched patterns land
- After 30-min cron cycle: log shows accurate report of what was reaped or "no-op"

## Related

Discovered while cleaning up post-r6g sprint. Root cause of the accumulation: previous session did not kill children when killing tmux panes (that itself is a xtrm/xtmux behavior gap — separate bead: consider making \`xt end\` / worktree remove kill child sp processes too).
